features.feature: Anthropic adapter: map native input_tokens/output_tokens/cache_creation_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens to provider-reported canonical shape
OpenAI adapter: map prompt_tokens->input, completion_tokens->output, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens->cacheRead, cacheCreation=null
Gemini adapter: map usageMetadata.promptTokenCount->input, candidatesTokenCount->output, cachedContentTokenCount->cacheRead, cacheCreation=null
Each adapter preserves raw provider units (providerUnits + payloadDigest) AND emits normalized canonical {input, output, cacheCreation, cacheRead} view
Per-dimension null semantics: unreported cache dimension = null (never 0, never via usage.source) across all three providers
Record assembler: provider response + locally-minted correlation ids (from ids.ts, never provider requestId) + attribution -> full validated ledger record passing B-253e validator
Correlation ids (ledgerCallId, attemptId, sequence, supersedesRecordIds) generated locally, not derived from provider.requestIdHash
Attribution fields (storyId nullable, phase, agentType) attached to assembled records at call time
Streaming: read final usage from terminal stream event (message_delta/final message) per provider
Mid-stream error/timeout: record partial usage consumed as provider-reported (not downgraded to unavailable/zero)
No provider usage at all -> source=unavailable + unavailableReason (never zeros)
Privacy: no raw prompt, transcript, provider secrets, customer API keys, actor keys, or authorization headers in ledger records
Smoke suite covering all three providers, assembler, streaming terminal-event and mid-stream-error, unavailable/null, and B-253e writer round-trip; wired as npm test:usage-ledger-adapter
Wiring adapters into live dispatch path (dispatch-runner / lattice-dispatch)
